name: clean-untrusted-v1
description: clean_untrusted(text, limit=2000): text from outside (relay messages, webhooks) before it goes into ticket history or an agent prompt. In this order: NFC; U+2028/U+2029 become newline; drop control (Cc) and format (Cf) characters except newline and tab, tag characters U+E0000-E007F, variation selectors U+FE00-FE0F and U+E0100-E01EF, U+2800, U+034F, U+3164, U+115F, U+1160, U+FEFF, U+FFA0; then remove <!-- ... --> comments, repeated until nothing changes; then remove an unterminated '<!--' and everything after it; cut to limit. Dropping invisible characters first means they cannot hide a comment marker. Visible text is never rewritten. The relay's description rule (relay-api.md PATCH /v1/me) already rejects what this strips.
